S56.01.needs: an outside account (Google) with Gmail connected on the web
S56.01.note: The search runs on the server through the Gmail connector; the extension only shows the chat, and the tool result was not run.
steps: Sign in to the extension and open the AGI sidebar chat.
In the Connected apps group, click the Ask with it row for Gmail (it is listed only when Gmail is connected on the web).
Type: find emails from a sender you know, and send.
Compare the reply with Expected: matching messages from that sender are listed.
S56.01.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Gmail > Ask with it, then type a search request

S56.02.needs: an outside account (Google) with Gmail connected on the web
S56.02.note: Whether the full body is returned depends on the server tool, which was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the Gmail row under Connected apps.
Type: open the latest email from a named sender and show the full text.
Compare the reply with Expected: the full body of that email is shown, not only a summary line.
S56.02.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Gmail > Ask with it, then type a read request

S56.03.needs: an outside account (Google) with Gmail connected on the web
S56.03.note: The Gmail scopes include gmail.compose for drafts, per packages/contracts/cloud-contracts/src/connector-scopes.ts; the draft itself was not checked.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the Gmail row under Connected apps.
Type: draft a reply to the latest email from a named sender, and do not send it.
Open Gmail in a browser and check the Drafts folder for the new draft, comparing with Expected.
S56.03.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Gmail > Ask with it, then type a draft request

S56.07.needs: an outside account (Google) with Google Calendar connected on the web
S56.07.note: The calendar connector id is google-calendar in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts; no visible display name for it was found there.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the Google Calendar row under Connected apps.
Type: what events do I have next Tuesday, or search for the word standup.
Compare the reply with the calendar in Google Calendar, using Expected as the test.
S56.07.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Google Calendar > Ask with it, then type a calendar request

S56.13.needs: an outside account (Google or Microsoft) with a cloud drive connected on the web
S56.13.note: Google Drive has connector id google-drive in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts with no display name found; the search was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on a cloud drive row under Connected apps (OneDrive or Google Drive).
Type: find files named with a word you know in that drive.
Compare the reply with Expected: matching files from the drive are listed.
S56.13.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > OneDrive or Google Drive > Ask with it, then type a file search request

S56.14.needs: an outside account (Google or Microsoft) with a cloud drive connected on the web
S56.14.note: The download behaviour is a server tool and was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on a cloud drive row under Connected apps.
Type: open the file named with a word you know and show its text.
Compare the reply with Expected: the text of that file is shown.
S56.14.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > OneDrive or Google Drive > Ask with it, then type a read request

S56.15.needs: an outside account (Google or Microsoft) with a cloud drive connected on the web
S56.15.note: Google Drive creation is limited to the drive.file scope and OneDrive to its app folder, per packages/contracts/cloud-contracts/src/connector-scopes.ts.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on a cloud drive row under Connected apps.
Type: create a new text file named with a test word in that drive.
When the approval prompt appears in the chat, read it and choose approve or deny; then check the drive for the new file against Expected.
S56.15.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > OneDrive or Google Drive > Ask with it, then type a create request

S56.16.needs: an outside account (Google or Microsoft) with a cloud drive connected on the web, and a file you can safely change
S56.16.note: Editing rights depend on the drive scopes; the edit was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on a cloud drive row under Connected apps.
Type: add one line that says a test word to a file you created in that drive.
When the approval prompt appears, read it and choose approve or deny.
Open the file in the drive and check the new line against Expected.
S56.16.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > OneDrive or Google Drive > Ask with it, then type an edit request

S56.17.needs: a cloud drive connected on the web
S56.17.note: Searched connector-scopes.ts and connectors.ts for folder or sharing scopes; only drive.file creation and OneDrive app-folder scopes were found, with no sharing or collaborator scope.

S56.22.needs: an outside account (Slack) with Slack connected on the web and a test channel
S56.22.note: The approval prompt is built by the approval_requested path in apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/ChatStateManager.ts; its exact wording was not confirmed.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the Slack row under Connected apps (Slack must be connected on the web).
Type: draft a short status message for a named channel and post it.
When the approval prompt appears, read the channel name and text, then approve or deny.
Open the Slack channel and compare the posted message with Expected.
S56.22.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Slack > Ask with it, then type a posting request

S56.23.needs: an outside account (Notion or Atlassian) with the knowledge base connected on the web
S56.23.note: Notion (id notion) and Confluence (id confluence) are in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts; no display names for them were found there, and the search was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on a Notion or Confluence row under Connected apps.
Type: search the knowledge base for a page title you know.
Compare the reply with Expected: matching pages from that workspace are listed.
S56.23.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Notion or Confluence > Ask with it, then type a search request

S56.26.needs: an outside account (Atlassian or Linear) with a tracker connected on the web and a test issue
S56.26.note: Linear is connector id linear in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts; the update was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the Jira row under Connected apps (or Linear, if connected).
Type: move a named test issue to In Progress, or change its priority.
When the approval prompt appears, read it and approve or deny.
Open the issue in Jira and compare its status or field with Expected.
S56.26.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Jira > Ask with it, then type an issue update request

S56.28.needs: an outside account (HubSpot or Salesforce) with the CRM connected on the web
S56.28.note: Salesforce is connector id salesforce in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts; the lookup was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the HubSpot row under Connected apps (Salesforce is the other CRM connector).
Type: find the contact or account for a company name you know.
Compare the reply with the CRM record and Expected.
S56.28.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > HubSpot > Ask with it, then type a lookup request

S56.31.needs: a folder open in VS Code; a GitHub account connected on the web for hosted search
S56.31.note: Local search is run by the local runtime (apps/extension-vscode/src/integrations/localRuntimeClient.ts); the 'Code: Show Connectors' command only opens the connector list, so it is not the search control.
steps: Open a folder that has a project in it, then open the AGI sidebar chat.
Type a question about the code, for example: where is a function name you know defined.
For a hosted repository, click Ask with it on the GitHub row under Connected apps (GitHub must be connected on the web).
Compare the reply with the file and line in the editor, using Expected as the test.
S56.31.where: Code: Show Connectors (Command Palette) for hosted repos; for the local checkout, sidebar chat > type a code question

S56.32.needs: an outside account (GitHub) with GitHub connected on the web and a test pull request
S56.32.note: The GitHub connector summary in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts lists pull request diffs, issue comments and PR reviews; the review was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the GitHub row under Connected apps (GitHub must be connected on the web).
Type: review pull request number N in a named repository and list the review comments.
When the approval prompt appears for posting comments, read it and approve or deny.
Open the pull request on GitHub and compare the comments with Expected.
S56.32.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > GitHub > Ask with it, then type a pull request request

S56.35.needs: an outside account (Figma) with Figma connected on the web and a design file
S56.35.note: Figma is connector id figma in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts; no display name was found in display-name.ts, and the lookup was not run.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the Figma row under Connected apps (Figma must be connected on the web).
Paste a link to a Figma frame and ask for the code references for it.
Compare the reply with the design file in Figma, using Expected as the test.
S56.35.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > Figma > Ask with it, then paste a Figma link

S56.36.needs: a database connector connected on the web or a database added by URL
S56.36.note: Searched the connector catalog, display names and scopes: only a read-only BigQuery query scope and a Snowflake MCP entry added by URL were found; no general database connector was confirmed as a chat tool.

S56.46.needs: an outside health provider account in the United States, with HealthEx connected on the web
S56.46.note: HealthEx is connector id healthex (category Healthcare, United States only) in apps/web/features/connectors/data/connectors.ts; its display name was not found in display-name.ts.
steps: Open the AGI sidebar chat.
Click Ask with it on the HealthEx row under Connected apps (HealthEx must be connected on the web).
Type: list my recent lab results from my care provider.
Compare the reply with the records in the provider's portal, using Expected as the test.
S56.46.where: Sidebar chat start screen > Connected apps > HealthEx > Ask with it, then type a records request
